<thought>The mass spectrum shows a clear isotopic envelope with peaks spaced by ~1.003 Da and decreasing intensities (≈100 : 8 : 0.5 : 0.02 …). This pattern matches the natural 13C/12C isotopic distribution for a molecule containing several carbon atoms (≈7–8 C atoms give ~8 % M+1 intensity). No 2‑Da spacing or other distinctive patterns for Cl, Br, S, etc., are present, so only carbon can be identified with confidence.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
